max_listed.title: Maximum listed results
max_listed.summary: Caps the number of matches or items returned in a list.
max_listed.description: A lower cap produces shorter reports even when additional candidates exist in the source.

verify.title: Verify references
verify.summary: Controls whether reference evidence is independently checked.
verify.description: When enabled, the tool attempts to verify evidence rather than relying only on model-generated claims.

passages.title: Passage count
passages.summary: Sets the number of evidence passages considered.
passages.description: Controls how many retrieved passages can contribute to the tool result.

passage_tokens.title: Passage token budget
passage_tokens.summary: Limits tokens devoted to retrieved evidence passages.
passage_tokens.description: Constrains the amount of passage text supplied for model analysis.

retry_passages.title: Retry passages
retry_passages.summary: Sets passage count for an additional verification pass.
retry_passages.description: An extended retrieval pass can look for more evidence when the initial reference check is inconclusive.

focus_claims.title: Focus on claims
focus_claims.summary: Prioritizes explicit claims for reference checking.
focus_claims.description: Concentrates verification work on claims that need evidence.

max_checked_claims.title: Maximum checked claims
max_checked_claims.summary: Caps the number of claims checked in one operation.
max_checked_claims.description: Controls the maximum scope of claim-by-claim reference review.

quick_claims.title: Quick-pass claims
quick_claims.summary: Limits claims examined during a quick check.
quick_claims.description: Keeps the faster checking mode bounded.

confirmation.title: Confirmation policy
confirmation.summary: Controls when user confirmation is required before a tool runs.
confirmation.description: Depending on the selected policy, the tool may ask before processing large or otherwise costly workloads.

large_batches.title: Large workload threshold
large_batches.summary: Sets the batch threshold used by the confirmation policy.
large_batches.description: Used to decide whether a planned multi-batch operation is large enough to request confirmation.

online_lookup.title: Online lookup
online_lookup.summary: Allows optional lookup of external reference evidence.
online_lookup.description: Enabling it permits online source queries when the corresponding service is available; it may contact external resources.

max_online.title: Maximum online lookups
max_online.summary: Caps the number of online source lookups.
max_online.description: Limits the external requests that reference checking can attempt.
